common_execution.checkpoint_resume: not supported; replay from immutable input; completed validated artifacts retained on failure/cancellation

resource_semantics.force_calls: For a completed primary leg n+1, or independent h/h2/h4 legs 7n+3; all attempted calls count.
resource_semantics.pair_work: N*(N-1)/2 times planned total force evaluations
resource_semantics.output_frames: F=1+ceil(n/sample_stride); reserve L*(F+1), L=1 or3 including terminal partial frame.
resource_semantics.whole_run_bytes: Authored revision, generic plan/provenance, standalone solver report, trajectories, states and terminal artifacts all count against one run ceiling; the adapter cannot enlarge it.
resource_semantics.failure: Refuse exceeded requests explicitly; no automatic timestep/precision/sampling reductions.
